push_up.name: Push-ups
push_up.description: Body straight from head to heels, elbows at 45° from your torso. Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor, then push up explosively.

pec_deck.name: Pec deck (machine)
pec_deck.description: Seated on the machine, bring your arms together in an arc in front of you. Control the return slowly to stretch the pecs.

cable_fly.name: Cable crossover
cable_fly.description: Standing between two pulleys, bring the cables together in front of you in an arc. Keep a slight bend in the elbows throughout.

bench_press_db.name: Dumbbell bench press
bench_press_db.description: Lying on the bench, dumbbells at chest level, elbows at 75°. Press up, bringing the dumbbells together without touching at the top. More range of motion than the barbell.

bench_press.name: Barbell bench press
bench_press.description: Shoulder blades squeezed into the bench, lower the bar to your lower chest. Elbows at 75°, press straight up without lifting your hips.

incline_press.name: Incline dumbbell press
incline_press.description: Bench at 30-45°, dumbbells at upper-chest level. Press up, focusing the work on your upper pecs.

incline_press_bb.name: Incline barbell press
incline_press_bb.description: Bench at 30-45°, lower the bar to your upper chest. Allows heavier loads than dumbbells to stimulate the upper pecs.

dips_chest.name: Dips (chest)
dips_chest.description: Lean your torso forward (30-45°) to target the pecs. Lower to a 90° elbow bend, then push up while squeezing your chest.

fly_dumbbell.name: Dumbbell fly
fly_dumbbell.description: Lying down, lower the dumbbells in an arc until you feel a stretch in your pecs. Come back up without locking your elbows.

decline_press.name: Decline dumbbell press
decline_press.description: Decline bench, targets the lower pecs. Keep elbows at 75° from your torso and press toward the ceiling.

guillotine_press.name: Guillotine press
guillotine_press.description: Lower the bar toward your neck with a wide grip. Maximizes the pec stretch but requires healthy shoulders. Use a spotter.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat_pulldown.description: Wide grip, pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back. Start the movement with your lats.

seated_row.name: Seated cable row
seated_row.description: Seated, back straight, pull the handle to your belly button. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end, control the return.

face_pull.name: Face pull
face_pull.description: High pulley, pull the rope toward your face, spreading your hands to each side of your head. Great for shoulder health.

pull_up.name: Pull-ups
pull_up.description: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Start with your lats, pull until your chin is over the bar. Keep your core tight.

barbell_row.name: Barbell row
barbell_row.description: Torso at 45°, knees slightly bent. Pull the bar to your lower sternum, back flat and elbows close to your body.

one_arm_row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
one_arm_row.description: One knee and one hand on the bench. Pull the dumbbell toward your hip with a slight torso rotation. Elbow high at the top.

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.description: Feet hip-width apart, bar over your shins. Push the floor away without rounding your back, keep the bar very close to your body throughout.

chest_supported.name: Chest-supported incline row
chest_supported.description: Chest on an incline bench, pull the dumbbells toward your hips. Removes lower-back cheating to isolate the back.

chin_up.name: Chin-ups
chin_up.description: Underhand grip (palms facing you), shoulder-width. Pull until your chin is over the bar. Works the biceps more than overhand pull-ups.

tbar_row.name: T-bar row
tbar_row.description: Bar in a landmine, V-handle, torso at 45°. Pull toward your sternum while squeezing your shoulder blades. Lets you go heavy safely.

pullover_db.name: Dumbbell pullover
pullover_db.description: Lying across the bench, dumbbell held with both hands. Bring your straight arms behind your head, elbows slightly bent. Stretches the lats.

pendlay_row.name: Pendlay row
pendlay_row.description: Bar on the floor, torso horizontal. Pull explosively to your lower sternum and set the bar back down on every rep.

meadows_row.name: Meadows row
meadows_row.description: Bar in a landmine, stand perpendicular to it. Pull toward your hip with a torso rotation. Large range of motion.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral raises
lateral_raise.description: Dumbbells in a neutral grip, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height. Slight elbow bend, thumbs slightly down.

dumbbell_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell_press.description: Seated or standing, elbows at 90° at the bottom. Press the dumbbells overhead without locking your elbows. Brace your core.

front_raise.name: Front raises
front_raise.description: Raise one arm (or both) in front of you to shoulder height. Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging.

ohp.name: Barbell overhead press
ohp.description: Bar at collarbone level, squeeze your glutes and brace. Press straight overhead, keeping the bar in line.

arnold_press.name: Arnold press
arnold_press.description: Dumbbells in front of your face, palms facing you. As you press, open your elbows and rotate your wrists outward. Works all 3 delt heads.

rear_delt_fly.name: Dumbbell reverse fly (rear delts)
rear_delt_fly.description: Bent forward, arms slightly bent, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height. Targets the often-neglected rear delts.

upright_row.name: Upright row
upright_row.description: Bar or dumbbells against your body, pull toward your chin with elbows high. Be careful if you have a history of shoulder problems.

machine_shoulder.name: Machine shoulder press
machine_shoulder.description: Seated in the machine, press the handles overhead. Ideal for beginners: no balance to manage, focus on the contraction.

cable_lateral.name: Cable lateral raises
cable_lateral.description: Low pulley at your side, raise your arm in an arc to shoulder height. The constant cable tension better targets the side delt.

behind_neck_press.name: Behind-the-neck press
behind_neck_press.description: Bar behind your neck, press up. Only for lifters with excellent mobility and no shoulder weakness.

dumbbell_curl.name: Alternating dumbbell curl
dumbbell_curl.description: Alternating arms, curl the dumbbell to your shoulder, turning your wrist up at the top. Elbow fixed against your body, control the descent.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer curl
hammer_curl.description: Neutral grip (thumbs up), curl the dumbbell to your shoulder. Works the brachialis and brachioradialis in addition to the biceps.

cable_curl.name: Cable curl
cable_curl.description: Low pulley, curl with a straight or EZ bar. Constant cable tension maximizes biceps work at the bottom of the movement.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell curl
barbell_curl.description: Straight or EZ bar, curl with both arms keeping your elbows fixed against your body. Lower slowly.

incline_curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline_curl.description: Lying on an incline bench, arms hanging behind you. Maximal stretch on the biceps long head at the bottom.

preacher_curl.name: Preacher curl
preacher_curl.description: Arms resting on the angled pad. The arm is stabilized, no cheating possible. Intensely targets the biceps short head.

concentration_curl.name: Concentration curl
concentration_curl.description: Seated, elbow braced against your inner thigh. Curl, turning your wrist up at the top. Peak biceps contraction.

spider_curl.name: Spider curl
spider_curl.description: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down. Perfectly isolates the biceps without shoulder cheating.

bayesian_curl.name: Bayesian curl (high pulley)
bayesian_curl.description: Pulley behind you, curl your elbow forward. Peak tension happens in the stretched position, very effective.

tricep_pushdown.name: Rope pushdown
tricep_pushdown.description: High pulley with a rope, elbows fixed at your sides. Push down to full extension, spreading the rope at the bottom.

overhead_ext.name: Dumbbell overhead extension
overhead_ext.description: Dumbbell overhead, bend your elbows behind your head. Targets the long head. Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.

dips_triceps.name: Bench dips (triceps)
dips_triceps.description: Hands on the bench behind you, torso upright and close to the bench. Bend your elbows to 90° and push back up without locking.

skull_crusher.name: Skull crusher (EZ bar)
skull_crusher.description: Lying down, lower the EZ bar to your forehead or behind your head. Elbows fixed pointing at the ceiling, full extension at the top.

close_grip_bench.name: Close-grip bench press
close_grip_bench.description: Bench press with a narrow grip (shoulder-width). Keep your elbows close to your body. Great for triceps mass.

dips_parallel.name: Parallel bar dips
dips_parallel.description: Between the bars, torso upright to target the triceps. Full extension at the top, 90° bend at the bottom. Add weight if too easy.

tricep_kickback.name: Dumbbell kickback
tricep_kickback.description: Bent forward, upper arm against your body, extend your elbow back to full extension. Keep the upper arm still, only the forearm moves.

cable_overhead_t.name: Cable overhead extension
cable_overhead_t.description: Facing away from the high pulley, rope behind your head. Extend your elbows forward keeping your upper arms still. Targets the long head.

tate_press.name: Tate press
tate_press.description: Dumbbells on your chest, elbows pointing up and out. Extend your elbows toward the ceiling while rotating your wrists.

jm_press.name: JM press
jm_press.description: Hybrid between a skull crusher and a close-grip press. The bar lowers toward your neck, elbows at 45°. Advanced, high triceps volume.

leg_press.name: Leg press
leg_press.description: Feet hip-width on the platform. Lower to 90° and push without locking your knees at the top. Back pressed into the seat.

leg_extension.name: Leg extension
leg_extension.description: Seated on the machine, extend your legs to the top while squeezing your quads. Lower slowly.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet_squat.description: Dumbbell held with both hands against your chest, feet shoulder-width. Squat down keeping your torso upright. Great for learning the squat.

lunge.name: Dumbbell lunges
lunge.description: Step forward, back knee 2 cm from the floor. Front knee in line with your foot, torso upright. Push through the front foot to return.

walking_lunge.name: Walking lunges
walking_lunge.description: Walk forward lunge by lunge, alternating legs. More dynamic than static lunges. Add dumbbells or a bar to progress.

step_up.name: Dumbbell step-up
step_up.description: Put one foot on a bench, push to step up keeping your torso upright. Works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

squat.name: Barbell squat
squat.description: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width. Squat to parallel keeping your torso upright and knees in line with your feet.

bulgarian_squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian_squat.description: Back foot on the bench, front foot forward. Lower keeping your torso upright. Great for fixing imbalances.

hack_squat.name: Hack squat (machine)
hack_squat.description: Back against the machine, feet slightly forward. Lower to at least 90°. Safer for the back than the barbell squat.

front_squat.name: Front squat
front_squat.description: Bar on your collarbones, torso very upright. Requires good ankle and shoulder mobility. Intensely targets the quads.

sissy_squat.name: Sissy squat
sissy_squat.description: Heels raised, lean your torso back while bending your knees forward. Intense quad isolation.

leg_curl.name: Lying leg curl
leg_curl.description: Lying on the machine, curl your heels toward your glutes. Hips pressed against the bench. Lower slowly.

rdl.name: Romanian deadlift
rdl.description: Bar against your legs, hinge your torso forward with knees slightly bent. Lower until your hamstrings stretch, then come back up.

good_morning.name: Good morning
good_morning.description: Bar on your upper back, hinge forward until your torso is horizontal. Back flat, knees slightly bent. Drive your hips forward to come up.

seated_leg_curl.name: Seated leg curl
seated_leg_curl.description: Seated on the machine, curl your legs under the seat. The seated position lengthens the hamstrings at the top for a fuller stretch.

nordic_curl.name: Nordic curl
nordic_curl.description: Knees on the floor, feet anchored. Lean forward while resisting with your hamstrings. A very intense eccentric exercise.

lying_leg_curl.name: Lying cable leg curl
lying_leg_curl.description: Lying flat, low pulley attached to your ankles. Constant cable tension works the hamstrings through the whole range.

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.description: Lying on your back, feet flat. Lift your hips, squeezing your glutes hard at the top. Hold 1 second at the top.

sumo_squat.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
sumo_squat.description: Wide stance, toes out, dumbbell between your legs. The wide stance works the glutes and adductors more.

cable_kickback.name: Cable kickback
cable_kickback.description: Low pulley attached to your ankle, torso slightly leaning. Kick your leg back and up while squeezing your glute.

hip_thrust.name: Barbell hip thrust
hip_thrust.description: Shoulders on the bench, bar on your hips. Drive your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes hard. Hold 1 second at the top.

rdl_glutes.name: Glute-focused Romanian deadlift
rdl_glutes.description: Classic RDL but with the intent to squeeze your glutes at the top. Drive your hips forward while squeezing your glutes.

banded_abduction.name: Banded abduction
banded_abduction.description: Band around your knees, push your legs apart against the resistance. Activates the often-neglected glute medius.

single_hip_thrust.name: Single-leg hip thrust
single_hip_thrust.description: Hip thrust on one leg to fix left/right imbalances. Doubles the resistance on the working glute.

standing_calf.name: Standing calf raise (machine)
standing_calf.description: Standing on the machine, rise onto your toes squeezing your calves. Lower into a full stretch and rise explosively.

seated_calf.name: Seated calf raise
seated_calf.description: Seated, knees at 90°, load on your knees. Targets the (deep) soleus. Full stretch at the bottom, squeeze at the top.

donkey_calf.name: Donkey calf raise
donkey_calf.description: Torso horizontal and supported, rise onto your toes. The bent-over position lengthens the gastrocnemius for a maximal stretch.

plank.name: Plank
plank.description: Body straight, on forearms and toes. Brace your abs, glutes and shoulders. Breathe normally without arching your back.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.description: On one forearm, body aligned sideways. Targets the obliques. Keep your hips high, don't let them drop.

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle_crunch.description: On your back, bring your right elbow to your left knee and vice versa, alternating. Works the obliques and rectus abdominis together.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.description: Lying on your back, lift your shoulders toward your knees. Lower back on the floor, don't pull on your neck. Exhale as you crunch.

leg_raise.name: Leg raise
leg_raise.description: Lying or hanging, raise your straight legs to 90°. Press your lower back into the floor (or brace if hanging). Control the descent.

cable_crunch.name: Cable crunch
cable_crunch.description: Kneeling at a high pulley, crunch your torso toward the floor bringing your elbows to your knees. Keep your hips still, all the movement comes from the abs.

russian_twist.name: Russian twist
russian_twist.description: Seated in a V (back leaning), rotate your torso from right to left. Add a plate or dumbbell to increase intensity.

ab_wheel.name: Ab wheel
ab_wheel.description: Kneeling, roll the wheel forward without arching your back. Come back squeezing your abs hard. Don't go further than you can control.

dragon_flag.name: Dragon flag
dragon_flag.description: On a bench, body rigid and supported on your shoulders. Lower your straight legs toward the floor and back up. Bruce Lee's exercise, very intense.

hanging_leg_raise.name: Hanging leg raise
hanging_leg_raise.description: Hanging from a bar, raise your straight legs to horizontal (or higher). Avoid swinging, control the descent.

machine_chest_press.name: Machine chest press
machine_chest_press.description: Guided machine, ideal for beginners or to finish a session. Adjust the seat so the handles are at lower-chest level.

diamond_push_up.name: Diamond push-ups
diamond_push_up.description: Hands close together forming a diamond under your chest. Intensely works the triceps and the sternal pecs.

push_up_feet_elevated.name: Feet-elevated push-ups
push_up_feet_elevated.description: Feet on a bench, body angled head-down. Targets the upper pecs like an incline press.

low_cable_fly.name: Low cable fly
low_cable_fly.description: Low pulleys, bring the cables up and to the center in an arc. Targets the upper pecs with constant tension.

push_up_ring.name: Ring push-ups
push_up_ring.description: Hands on gymnastic rings, maximal instability that deeply activates the pecs and stabilizers. Turn your wrists inward at the top.

landmine_press.name: Landmine press
landmine_press.description: Bar in a landmine, cupped with one or both hands, press up in an arc. Works the upper pecs and shoulders.

cable_fly_mid.name: Mid cable fly
cable_fly_mid.description: Pulleys at shoulder height, bring the cables together in front of you in an arc. A variation targeting the middle of the pecs.

narrow_lat_pulldown.name: Close-grip lat pulldown
narrow_lat_pulldown.description: High pulley with a V-handle or close grip. More range at the bottom, easier on the shoulders. Pull to your lower sternum.

machine_row.name: Machine row
machine_row.description: Guided machine, chest supported. Pull the handles toward you while squeezing your shoulder blades. Ideal for learning without lower-back cheating.

rack_pull.name: Rack pull
rack_pull.description: Partial deadlift from knee height. Lets you overload heavy to build upper-back and trap strength.

weighted_pull_up.name: Weighted pull-ups
weighted_pull_up.description: Pull-ups with a dip belt or a dumbbell between your feet. Ideal for progressing once bodyweight pull-ups are mastered.

seal_row.name: Seal row
seal_row.description: Chest lying on a raised bench, pull the dumbbells or bar to your lower sternum. Completely removes lower-back cheating.

straight_arm_pulldown.name: Straight-arm pulldown
straight_arm_pulldown.description: High pulley, arms straight, bring the bar down to your hips with elbows slightly bent. Isolates the lats without the biceps.

cable_row_single.name: Single-arm cable row
cable_row_single.description: Low pulley, pull with one arm toward your hip with a slight torso rotation. Fixes left/right imbalances.

assisted_pull_up.name: Assisted pull-ups (machine)
assisted_pull_up.description: Counterweight machine that reduces your bodyweight. Lets you learn the pull-up with a load suited to your level.

machine_lateral_raise.name: Machine lateral raises
machine_lateral_raise.description: Guided machine for lateral raises. The fixed path helps target the side delt without cheating. Control the return.

cable_rear_delt.name: Cable reverse fly
cable_rear_delt.description: Low pulley at your side or crossed, pull back and up in an arc. Constant tension on the rear delt.

lu_raise.name: Lu raises
lu_raise.description: Front raise + lateral raise + overhead reach in a single rep. Popularized by Lu Xiaojun, works the whole delt.

handstand_push_up.name: Handstand push-ups (HSPU)
handstand_push_up.description: Upside down against a wall, bend your elbows until your head touches the floor. Maximal strength and coordination.

z_press.name: Z-press
z_press.description: Seated on the floor with legs straight in front of you, press the bar or dumbbells overhead. Requires excellent hip and back mobility.

reverse_curl.name: Reverse curl
reverse_curl.description: Overhand grip (back of the hand up), classic curl. Targets the brachioradialis and the biceps.

zottman_curl.name: Zottman curl
zottman_curl.description: Curl up with palms up, then rotate to palms down for the descent. Combines the classic curl and reverse curl in one movement.

drag_curl.name: Drag curl
drag_curl.description: Drag the bar up along your body, moving your elbows back. Recruits the biceps long head more than a classic curl.

cross_body_cable_curl.name: Cross-body cable curl
cross_body_cable_curl.description: High pulley on the opposite side, curl toward your face. The arm rotation creates an exceptional peak contraction on the short head.

waiter_curl.name: Waiter curl
waiter_curl.description: Hold a single dumbbell cupped in both hands, elbows against your body. Keeps maximal supination throughout the movement.

pushdown_bar.name: Straight-bar pushdown
pushdown_bar.description: High pulley with a straight bar, elbows fixed at your sides. Full extension at the bottom. Lets you go heavier than the rope.

single_arm_cable_ext.name: Single-arm cable extension
single_arm_cable_ext.description: High pulley, one arm behind your head, extend your elbow. Fixes imbalances and increases the long head's range.

cable_kickback_tri.name: Cable triceps kickback
cable_kickback_tri.description: Low pulley, bent forward, elbow fixed at your side. Extend your arm back to full extension. Constant tension vs. dumbbell.

band_pushdown.name: Band pushdown
band_pushdown.description: Band anchored up high, classic pushdown. Ideal as a high-rep finisher for a triceps pump.

bench_dip_weighted.name: Weighted bench dips
bench_dip_weighted.description: Bench dips with a weight plate on your thighs. Adds resistance when bodyweight dips become too easy.

reverse_lunge.name: Dumbbell reverse lunges
reverse_lunge.description: Step one foot back into a lunge, back knee 2 cm from the floor. More stable than forward lunges, less stress on the front knee.

single_leg_press.name: Single-leg press
single_leg_press.description: Leg press on one leg to fix imbalances. Use 50-60% of your two-leg load.

high_foot_leg_press.name: High-foot leg press
high_foot_leg_press.description: Feet placed high on the platform, go deep. Shifts more load onto the hamstrings and glutes.

belt_squat.name: Belt squat
belt_squat.description: Load hung from a hip belt. Deep squat with no load on the spine, ideal for people with back problems.

split_squat.name: Split squat
split_squat.description: Static lunge position, lower and rise without moving your feet. Simple and effective single-leg work for the quads.

leg_press_close.name: Close-stance leg press
leg_press_close.description: Feet close together in the center of the platform. Targets the vastus lateralis and rectus femoris more.

hyperextension.name: Back extension
hyperextension.description: On the Roman chair, lean your torso forward and come back up to alignment. Works the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. Keep your back flat.

single_leg_rdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
single_leg_rdl.description: RDL on one leg, dumbbell in the opposite hand. Improves balance and fixes imbalances. Keep your back flat and hips level.

glute_ham_raise.name: Glute-ham raise
glute_ham_raise.description: On the GHR machine, lower your torso and squeeze your hamstrings to come back up. Combines knee flexion and hip extension for the hamstrings.

standing_leg_curl.name: Standing leg curl (machine)
standing_leg_curl.description: Standing machine, bend your knee to bring your heel toward your glute. One leg at a time, to spot and fix imbalances.

banded_good_morning.name: Banded good morning
banded_good_morning.description: Band under your feet and around your neck, hinge your torso forward. Beginner version of the good morning to learn the hip hinge.

clamshell.name: Clamshell
clamshell.description: Lying on your side, knees bent, open your top knee like a clamshell. Targets the glute medius and external rotators. Add a band.

fire_hydrant.name: Fire hydrant
fire_hydrant.description: On all fours, raise one bent knee out to the side to horizontal. Targets the glute medius. Keep your pelvis stable, don't let your back sag.

cable_pull_through.name: Cable pull-through
cable_pull_through.description: Back to the low pulley, grab the rope between your legs. Hinge forward, then drive your hips forward squeezing your glutes and hamstrings.

reverse_hyper.name: Reverse hyperextension
reverse_hyper.description: Upper body on the bench, raise your straight legs behind you. Targets the glutes and lower back while decompressing the spine.

sumo_squat_bb.name: Barbell sumo squat
sumo_squat_bb.description: Very wide stance, toes pointed at 45°, bar on your upper back. Works the glutes and adductors more than a regular squat.

donkey_kick.name: Donkey kick
donkey_kick.description: On all fours, push one foot toward the ceiling keeping your knee bent at 90°. Maximal glute squeeze at the top. Add a band.

single_calf_raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single_calf_raise.description: On one leg, rise onto your toes with your bodyweight or holding a dumbbell. Doubles the resistance and improves balance.

barbell_calf_raise.name: Barbell calf raise
barbell_calf_raise.description: Bar on your upper back, rise onto your toes. Lets you load heavier than the machine or bodyweight.

step_calf_raise.name: Step calf raise
step_calf_raise.description: Balls of your feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging. The extra range at the bottom gives a maximal calf stretch.

tibia_raise.name: Tibia raise
tibia_raise.description: Back against a wall, lift your toes while keeping your heels on the floor. Works the tibialis anterior, the often-neglected opposite of the calves.

hollow_body.name: Hollow body hold
hollow_body.description: Lying down, lower back pressed into the floor, straight arms and legs held a few cm off the floor. Body in an inverted banana shape. A key gymnastics position.

toes_to_bar.name: Toes to bar
toes_to_bar.description: Hanging from the bar, raise your toes until they touch the bar. Control the swing, start the movement with your abs, not your shoulders.

pallof_press.name: Pallof press
pallof_press.description: Side-on to a pulley, extend your arms in front of you and resist the rotation. Trains anti-rotation, key for core stability.

wood_chop.name: Wood chop
wood_chop.description: High or low pulley, rotate your torso diagonally in a controlled way. Works the obliques in rotation, a functional movement.

decline_crunch.name: Decline crunch
decline_crunch.description: On a decline bench, crunch toward your knees. The decline increases range and difficulty. Hold a plate on your chest.

flutter_kicks.name: Flutter kicks
flutter_kicks.description: Lying on your back, legs slightly off the floor, kick your feet alternately. Lower back pressed down, constant lower-ab work.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain climbers
mountain_climber.description: In push-up position, drive your knees toward your chest, alternating quickly. Combines core work and cardio. Keep your hips low.

l_sit.name: L-sit
l_sit.description: Supported on parallel bars or the floor, raise your straight legs to horizontal and hold. Requires exceptional ab and hip-flexor strength.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.description: On your back, arms and knees at 90°. Extend the opposite arm and leg at the same time keeping your lower back pressed down. Great for core control.

v_up.name: V-up
v_up.description: Raise your straight legs and torso at the same time to form a V. Touch your toes with your fingers. Squeeze your abs hard at the top.

techniqueNotes.superset: Do A and B back to back with no rest · Rest after B only
techniqueNotes.biset: Do the 2 exercises back to back with no rest · Rest after the 2nd
techniqueNotes.dropset: Last set: reduce the load by 20-30% at each failure (2-3 drops)
techniqueNotes.rest_pause: At failure → rest 15-20 s → continue to the next failure (2-3 mini-sets)
